fields.measuregrp.attrib: raw: kept in the group context; a manual or unreliable entry sets the manual_entry flag
fields.measuregrp.category: raw: only real measurements (1) are stored, user objectives are skipped
fields.measuregrp.date: raw: timestamp that sets the row time
fields.measuregrp.grpid: raw: identifier (external id of the group)
fields.measuregrp.measures[].type: raw: selects the code (meastype table in the normalizer)
fields.measuregrp.measures[].unit: raw: power of ten of the value
fields.measuregrp.measures[].value: weight, height, fat_free_mass, body_fat_ratio, fat_mass, bp_diastolic, bp_systolic, bp_pulse, heart_rate, body_temperature, spo2, skin_temperature, muscle_mass, hydration, bone_mass, pulse_wave_velocity, vo2max, vascular_age, extracellular_water, intracellular_water, visceral_fat_index, basal_metabolic_rate
fields.measuregrp.model_id: raw: device type derived from the model id
fields.timezone: raw: not used yet; the owner timezone applies
